notes: Read all 181 source lines with numbered output before editing. L1-27 module JSDoc (canonical-metric storage, display-unit render, blur/Enter parse, focus-guarded resync, drop-in usage, @example) is carried into the native header comment and expanded with the native adaptations.

L29-38 react imports (forwardRef/useCallback/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState) preserved; the web FocusEvent/KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement> type imports are dropped. The focus/blur/submit handlers are typed via NonNullable<TextInputProps['onFocus'|'onBlur'|'onSubmitEditing']> so they always match RN 0.81's FocusEvent/BlurEvent/TextInputSubmitEditingEvent signatures and forward the consumer's handlers without an explicit (now-deprecated) TextInputFocusEventData import.

L39 `import { Input, type InputProps } from '@/components/ui'`: no native Input primitive exists, so the field (label + text input + suffix + error/hint) is rebuilt inline from React Native View/TextInput + AppText; UnitInputProps now extends Omit<TextInputProps, 'value'|'onChange'|'onChangeText'|'defaultValue'> as the native analogue of Omit<InputProps, ...>.

L40 `import { useSettings } from '@/hooks/useSettings'`: web returns `{ settings }`; native parity uses the TanStack Query hook in ../../api/hooks/useSettings which returns `{ data }`. Ported as `const {data: settingsData} = useSettings(); const settings = settingsData ?? UNIT_INPUT_SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` (defaults mirror web's useSettings defaults for the unit-relevant fields).

L41-46 `import { formatForUnit, parseForUnit, unitSymbol, type UnitKind } from '@/lib/unitInput'`: no native lib module exists yet, so web/src/lib/unitInput.ts is inlined verbatim (UnitKind, ParseOptions, KM_PER_MI, distance/temp display<->canonical converters, resolveLocale, STRIPPABLE_SUFFIXES longest-first list, parseForUnit, formatForUnit, unitSymbol, parseLocaleNumber) and re-exported so the import surface is preserved -- same precedent as data-display/format/Currency.tsx inlining lib/numberFormat. Helpers are typed against the Pick<AppSettings,...> subset they actually read (behavior-equivalent to web taking full AppSettings).

L48-65 UnitInputProps ported: value:number|null (L54), onChange:(next:number|null)=>void (L56), unit:UnitKind (L58), parseStrict?:boolean (L64) preserved identically; plus label/error/hint/containerStyle as the native parity for the web Input affordances UnitInput forwarded. Web-only Input extras (className, size, help icon) have no native analogue and no consumer (only SmartChargePage uses <UnitInput> with label/unit/value/onChange) so they are intentionally omitted.

L67-90 component doc + forwardRef signature preserved: web forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, UnitInputProps> -> forwardRef<TextInput, UnitInputProps>; the same destructured props (value, onChange, unit, parseStrict, onBlur, onKeyDown, onFocus, label, ...rest) map to (value, onChange, unit, parseStrict, onBlur, onFocus, onSubmitEditing, label, error, hint, containerStyle, style, editable, ...rest) -- onKeyDown's Enter-commit role moves to onSubmitEditing; consumer onKeyPress flows through ...rest.

L91-100 `const { settings } = useSettings()` + the `display` (formatForUnit, deps [value,unit,settings]) and `symbol` (unitSymbol, deps [unit,settings]) useMemos preserved with identical dependency arrays.

L102-116 local buffer + focus guard preserved: `const [text, setText] = useState<string>(display)` and `focusedRef = useRef(false)` kept verbatim (the ref-not-state perf decision is honoured); the resync useEffect (`if (focusedRef.current) return; setText(display)`, deps [display]) is preserved, routed through a textRef-syncing applyText() so the blur handler can read the latest typed text (RN blur events lack web's e.currentTarget.value).

L118-127 commit() ported byte-for-byte: parseForUnit(raw, unit, settings, {strict: !!parseStrict}) -> onChange(parsed) -> setText(formatForUnit(parsed, unit, settings)) (via applyText), deps preserved [onChange, parseStrict, settings, unit] (+ stable applyText).
L129-135 handleFocus: sets focusedRef.current=true then onFocus?.(e) -- preserved, RN NativeSyntheticEvent<TextInputFocusEventData>.
L137-144 handleBlur: sets focusedRef.current=false, commit(value), onBlur?.(e) -- preserved; web's e.currentTarget.value becomes textRef.current (the live buffer).

L146-154 handleKeyDown Enter-commit -> handleSubmitEditing committing e.nativeEvent.text then onSubmitEditing?.(e) (typed via NonNullable<TextInputProps['onSubmitEditing']>), the reliable RN single-line return event; consumer onKeyPress is still forwarded via ...rest.

L156-181 render ported: web <Input ref label type='text' inputMode='decimal' autoComplete='off' value onChange onBlur onKeyDown onFocus suffix={...} {...rest}/> becomes a View(container) > optional AppText label + View(field) > TextInput (ref, value=text, onChangeText=applyText, onFocus/onBlur/onSubmitEditing, inputMode='decimal', autoComplete='off', autoCorrect=false, autoCapitalize='none', editable, ...rest) + the suffix AppText (L168-176: aria-hidden -> accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants'; className text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] -> variant='caption' tone='muted'; data-testid='unit-input-symbol' -> testID='unit-input-symbol') + an error/hint message line; displayName='UnitInput' (L180-181). type='text' is the TextInput default and dropped.

Native-safe contract honoured: no DOM, no browser HTML elements, no Recharts/Leaflet, no old web UI components imported; only React Native View/TextInput primitives, theme tokens, AppText, and the native useSettings query hook are used. Intl.NumberFormat/formatToParts are available under the native tsconfig lib (es2019 includes es2018.intl) and the jest (Node ICU) runtime, with the same try/catch en-US fallback as the source.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
